algorithm: v0.2 conditional moments; no KIRC ratio closure

data.missing_image_policy: fail inventory and list missing; never silently replace with one polarization or change 329 list
data.dedup_representative: E00 fixed source-free representative; never pick by AIS match/class/confidence
data.label_vocabulary: source-fit fine classes only; >=100 deduplicated labelled instances and >=3 source-fit ports; freeze. Otherwise report insufficient support; do not trim target pool by Y.
data.unlabelled_or_outside_vocabulary: score all; evaluator reports unresolved truth and target-outside-vocab separately. Not automatically unknown truth.

chips.crop: fixed native-resolution axis-aligned square centered on dedup object centroid; same geospatial window in both polarizations
chips.input_representation: existing uint8 display raster; not calibrated dB; record original display mapping
chips.float_or_uint16_policy: requires explicit frozen radiometry decoder; never auto minmax
chips.padding: outside=0 after normalization + validity mask; apply 0.95 gate
chips.storage: source-normalized or uint8 NPY shards with index; no millions of individual PNG required

encoder.name: SARResNet18GN
encoder.external_checkpoint_policy: only use if provenance excludes every fold target/meta/cal; otherwise train from scratch
encoder.AMP: bf16 if hardware supports, else fp32; record

augmentation.applies_to: source encoder training only; same transform VV/VH

candidate_bank.input: frozen z512 plus m4 standardized on source-fit
candidate_bank.B0_selection: maximum equal-port BA on source-meta-query; deterministic lowest head_id on tie
candidate_bank.collapse_diagnostic: pairwise prediction disagreement and source-meta oracle upper-bound; do not modify bank after target eval

grouping.feature: z512 only; no K, AIS, port, world_xy, Y, density or support
grouping.fit_pool: source-fit P0 image-valid objects, labelled and unlabelled; cap 2000/port by sample_id hash
grouping.source_cal_target_action: transform and nearest frozen centroid only
grouping.scope: T: each product scene; G: aggregate target adapt only, freeze retained bank for target eval

relations.density_provenance: E00 dedup/offshore leave-one-out counts; if counts were calculated before offshore filtering, recompute this column only

J_definition: J1: same data; hash halfA port weight x3, others x1
J2: same data; hash halfB port weight x3, others x1
relation_models.model: conditional moment regressor, not target label posterior
relation_models.unestimable_cell_policy: disable that D globally across J unless a separately declared pooled shrinkage model is used; do not fill zero

calibration.calibration_input: calibration-port adapt products, label-blind P0 pool and same masks
calibration.unavailable_policy: do not tune target; B1 + calibration_unavailable
calibration.uncertainty_claim: empirical held-out-port tolerance, not 90/95% distribution-free coverage
calibration.relation_mechanism_shared_scope: one J for all active groups within the decision scope

report.delta: Full minus B1 on identical evaluator objects
report.bootstrap_unit: acquisition clusters; report per-port effects; repeated seeds are not domains
report.complete_population: 408981 prespecified P0 records retained in registry even when I/O/validity prevents an image prediction; report attrition
report.label_missing: do not count as ground-truth unknown

runtime.torch_version: use installed runtime and record; do not reinstall CUDA/PyTorch based on this config
